title: Export writes the file
text: Until you export, changes live only in this session: the status bar shows “Unexported changes”. Exporting writes the real save.

title: Review before exporting
text: The review modal lets you include or exclude, one by one, each edited Pokémon, the trainer, the bag and any releases.

title: Two independent languages
text: In Preferences you choose “Interface language” and, separately, “Game data language” (species, moves, items…). The status bar indicator shows both.

title: F1 and shortcuts
text: F1 opens this guide. Help → “Keyboard shortcuts” has the full list: open, save, export, close…

title: Search by name or number
text: The species picker filters as you type, ignoring case and accents.

title: Quick jumps with the keyboard
text: Hold Shift while using the arrow keys to jump 10% of the results at once. Home and End go to the extremes.

title: Only species from the game are offered
text: The picker hides species that don't exist in the save's game or can't be created legally (for example, outside the Hisui Pokédex in Legends: Arceus, or outside Galar and Paldea in Sword/Shield and Scarlet/Violet).

title: Forms and special cases
text: Some forms can't be made legal when created (such as Zygarde 10%/50% or Ash-Greninja in Legends: Z-A) and don't appear. If a species shows legality alerts, check the “Legal” tab and fix from top to bottom.

title: IVs and EVs by generation
text: In Gen 1–2 they are DVs (0–15) and Stat Exp (0–65535). The editor adjusts the ranges by itself based on the save's game.

title: Recommended sets
text: The “Sets” tab shows Smogon and Showdown sets for the species, with ability, item, nature and EVs.

title: Mega, Z, Dynamax and Tera
text: Mega Stones, Z-Crystals and each game's other mechanics are chosen in the “Special” tab, not in the item field.

title: Ribbons by game
text: Only the ribbons that exist in the loaded save's generation are shown.

title: Releasing a Pokémon
text: The release button is on each Pokémon, eggs included. A dialog asks you to confirm and warns you if it holds an item: the item is lost with it.

title: The only Pokémon in the party
text: The app won't let you release it, because the game needs at least one in the party. Move another Pokémon to the party and try again.

title: Undo has limits
text: Until you export you can undo with “Undo” on the notice or by discarding the edits. It's not possible if the party or box has filled up, or if another Pokémon took that slot.

title: Keeping one when exporting
text: In the review modal you can untick a release to keep that Pokémon, but only in boxes from Gen 3 on, with the slot still free and no edits on it. In the party and in Gen 1–2 boxes, releasing shifts the others: use “Undo” there.

title: Bag categories
text: The bag is split into categories (items, medicine, balls, TMs/HMs…) and which ones exist depends on the save's generation. Tap one to see and edit its items.

title: Adding or removing items
text: Each category lists every legal item, owned or not. Raise the quantity (or tick the item) to add it and lower it to 0 to remove it.

title: Maximum quantity
text: “MAX” sets the quantity to that category's cap in that game. If you type a larger number, it snaps to the cap by itself.

title: Search and switching to PC
text: The search box filters by name or description inside the category. In generations with separate storage, the ◀ ▶ arrows switch between Bag and PC.

title: Start with the first step
text: The steps in the “Legal” tab are ordered by dependency: encounter, origin game and egg first. Fix from top to bottom and many errors below disappear on their own.

title: Red and amber are different
text: “Blocks legality” makes the Pokémon illegal. “Suspicious, review” is a warning: it may be a rare but valid case. Prioritise the red ones.

title: When “Fix automatically” appears
text: Only when the app can work out the correct value (PID, catch rate, level or origin). For everything else, touch the highlighted field and follow the step's suggestion.

title: Some fixes search at random
text: Fixing the PID tries combinations and sometimes finds nothing. If it fails, press “Retry”.

title: Edited IVs that break the encounter
text: In some encounters the IVs come from a game seed, and changing them by hand makes them illegal. This notice then appears: use it to find legal IVs.

title: If there is no exact match
text: The search shows the closest one, how many IV points it differs by and what else would change (nature, ability, gender, shiny). Nothing is applied until you confirm; “Back to the original IVs” undoes it.

title: Invalid origin: recreate it
text: “Recreate with a valid encounter” offers legal origins. Species, level, moves, nickname, item, trainer and IVs are kept; place, ball and other capture data change. You'll see what changes before applying.

title: “No automatic fix”
text: If no encounter matches its moves, change them to legal ones (“Go to Moves”) and check again: if a compatible encounter shows up, the fix is offered automatically.

title: Legal moves with “Learnsets”
text: The “Learnsets” tab shows how each move is learned (level, TM, egg, tutor, reminder) and from which level.

title: Nickname, language and technical detail
text: If the nickname doesn't match any valid language, tick the checkbox next to the nickname field. “Technical detail” shows PKHeX's original message, useful when asking for help.
